    def _recent_branch(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        emb = self.item_emb(seq) * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
        # Prefix differences pool [max(0,t-window+1), t], never the next target.
        prefix = torch.cat([torch.zeros_like(emb[:, :1]), emb.cumsum(dim=1)], dim=1)

            [valid.new_zeros((seq.size(0), 1), dtype=torch.long),
             valid.long().cumsum(dim=1)], dim=1
